comparison.objective: Arrange two bevelled steel coupons for a single-V butt weld with the specified root opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Part reorientation, bevel recognition, planar alignment, and controlled gap setting.
comparison.success_condition: Both coupons flat and still, bevels facing, 1.6–3.2 mm gap at both ends, ends aligned, held for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Static fit-up and gap measurement differ from dynamic sliding across a contact-maintained interface with internal element-loss hazards.
